title: The map release: the shared map on the site's colours; a trip's route in Electric Lime over a Deep Umber casing, the chosen day lime
why: brand.md §4's note (Jason, 2026-11-19): routes and trails are Electric Lime #B6F22E over a Deep Umber #3E2B1F casing (--tv-route, --tv-route-casing); admin-design.md: the first map that draws routes uses both, the casing 2px wider. js/map-view.js, every full-screen map, moves onto the tokens, colours only (the panel's words read at 4.5:1 or better: 6 under it before, 0 after); Leaflet's lines are SVG, where var() doesn't resolve, so the radius ring reads its token's value at run time. The trip page's day lines become the route colour: the chosen day lime over its casing, the other days casing only, faded (option B, Jason's pick in the release's pop-up); a Route row over the map (Day 1, Day 2…) or tapping a day's stop chooses a day; a one-day trip has no row. Pins keep their day colours. FAQ: the trip entry says so. No data changes, no outside calls, no cost.
